title: On the tradeoff between robustness and geometric accuracy in adversarial training
abstract: arXiv:2610.22955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For non-parametric binary classification in the presence of an adversary, we prove an optimal quantitative estimate for adversarial classifiers controlling geometric accuracy, as measured by the Hausdorff distance to the Bayes classifier, in terms or their robustness, as encoded by the adversarial budget $\varepsilon$. This rigorously shows that robust classifiers sacrifice at most $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ or $O(\varepsilon)$ in accuracy, depending on the regularity of the underlying Bayes classifier. In contrast to prior work on the incompatibility of robustness and accuracy over low-complexity hypothesis classes, our work shows that high-complexity hypothesis classes allow for robust classifiers with precisely quantified accuracy. Our results apply for adversaries determined by any norm on Euclidean space and in both the infinite and finite data settings.

translated_title: 论对抗训练中鲁棒性与几何精度之间的权衡
translated_abstract: 在存在对抗者的非参数二分类问题中，我们为对抗分类器证明了一个最优的定量估计，该估计以到贝叶斯分类器的Hausdorff距离所衡量的几何精度为控制目标，并以对抗预算ε所编码的鲁棒性为依据。这严格地表明，鲁棒分类器在精度上的牺牲至多为O(√ε)或O(ε)，具体取决于底层贝叶斯分类器的正则性。与先前关于低复杂度假设类上鲁棒性与精度不相容性的工作不同，我们的工作表明，高复杂度假设类允许存在精度被精确量化的鲁棒分类器。我们的结果适用于由欧几里得空间上任意范数所确定的对抗者，并且在无限数据和有限数据两种设置中均成立。
tldr: 该论文证明了对抗分类器的几何精度损失与对抗预算ε之间的最优定量权衡关系——鲁棒分类器至多牺牲O(√ε)或O(ε)的精度，从而表明在高复杂度假设类中，鲁棒性与精度可以以精确量化的方式共存。
en_tdlr: This paper proves an optimal quantitative tradeoff between geometric accuracy and adversarial budget ε for adversarial classifiers, showing that robust classifiers sacrifice at most O(√ε) or O(ε) in accuracy, and demonstrating that high-complexity hypothesis classes admit robust classifiers with precisely quantified accuracy.
